name: Irojikake Gakuen~ Shishunki Danshi Yūwaku Sakusen 2~
original_name: 色仕掛け学園～思春期男子誘惑作戦2～
source:
The protagonist is an honor student with tip-top grades and impeccable study habits.
However, with important tests coming up, suddenly, girls are starting to seduce him...!?
What of his study club? What of his grades? Can he resist this temptation,
or will he let his academic pursuits fall to the wayside in favor of lust!?
It seems these girls have a full-proof plan for keeping their grades on top...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ309157.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名成绩优异、学习习惯无可挑剔的优等生。
然而，随着重要考试的临近，突然间，女孩们开始诱惑他……！？
他的学习俱乐部呢？他的成绩怎么样？他能否抵挡住这样的诱惑，
或者他会让他的学术追求因欲望而半途而废！？
看来这些女孩有一个全面的计划来保持她们的成绩名列前茅……
